title: Core Awakening
tagline: Rebuild your identity from the wreckage of fallen Titans.
pitch: In a compact arena, you control a modular mech, tactically dismantling enemies to reclaim lost components. Your choices during combat shape your capabilities and identity, leading to a thrilling experience of tactical decision-making.
coreLoop: Read enemy attacks, dodge or interrupt, target and dismantle subsystems, and choose how to recover components for future use.

mechanics.name: Evade & Interrupt
mechanics.description: Players can dodge incoming attacks and interrupt enemy actions, creating openings for counter-attacks.

mechanics.name: Subsystem Targeting
mechanics.description: Combat involves targeting different subsystems of enemies, each with its own consequences when destroyed or preserved.

mechanics.name: Three-Way Decision
mechanics.description: After defeating an enemy, choose between installing a component for immediate benefit, securing it for extraction, or dismantling it for instant repairs.

controls.keyboard: WASD for movement, mouse for aiming and targeting
controls.mouse: Left click to execute action on targeted subsystem

audioDirection.musicMood: ambient futuristic tones with subtle tension

difficulty.start: Introduction to enemy attacks with basic telegraphs.
difficulty.progression: Slowly increase enemy complexity and challenge with multiple attack patterns.
difficulty.peak: Encounter tactical nuances that require critical thinking to survive.

winLose.win: Successfully extract salvaged components after defeating the enemy.
winLose.lose: The mech's core integrity reaches zero from taking damage.

juice.screenShake: When the mech takes damage or successfully hits an enemy subsystem.
juice.particles: When components are dismantled or salvaged.
juice.flash: When an enemy is defeated or a decision is made.

scopeNotes: Do not build procedural dungeons, economy/shop systems, multiple enemy types, bosses, inventory management, crafting, upgrades between runs, or extensive narrative scenes.

scoreEvents: Score increases for every enemy defeated and component salvaged.
